title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.36077v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. tldr: 提出了The Trinity递归自我改进框架，通过Creator、Explorer、Evolver三个角色将世界生成与Harness进化相耦合，并以共享能力需求为基础将任务树重组为分层能力树，从而实现多模态智能体的能力驱动自我进化。
en_tdlr: The Trinity is a recursive self-improvement framework that couples world generation with Harness evolution through three roles (Creator, Explorer, and Evolver), reorganizing the task tree into a hierarchical capability tree based on shared capability requirements to enable capability-driven self-improvement for multimodal agents.
